name: koi-pond
description: Koi across the band above the prompt: a pond seen from above, or a tank seen from the side. Koi swim while you type, dart while Claude works, rest as the context window fills, and come to eat when a turn finishes (with a bloop).

view.title: View
view.description: pond: koi from above, lily pads, food on the water. tank: koi from the side behind glass, with gravel, weed, a stone, driftwood, a bubbler, a snail, and flakes that flutter as they sink.

sound.description: Play a soft bloop when a turn finishes.
sound.title: Bloop on finished turns

algae.description: Tank only: algae slowly grows on the glass and the decor over a session, and the snail grazes it. Fresh each session.
algae.title: Algae (tank)

rows.description: Height of the pond in terminal rows (4 to 8).
rows.title: Pond height (rows)

fish.title: Koi drawing
fish.description: dots: braille, finer and stippled, one colour a cell. pixels: half blocks, two colours a cell, steady markings.

water.title: Water
water.description: clear: the terminal's own background. dots: a sparse field of dim blue dots (pond).

idleMinutes.title: Idle stop (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Minutes after the last prompt, turn, model request, press or input before the pond stops moving and the fish stand still; the next one starts it again. 0 keeps it moving all session. Fractions work: 0.5 is thirty seconds, 0.1 is six.

fps.title: Frame rate
fps.description: Frames a second while the pond is awake. The koi swim at the same speed at any rate; a higher one is smoother and costs more CPU (about 13% of a core a session at 4, 21-26% at 10, a core at 60), so pair it with a shorter idle stop. 2: drowsy koi only. 4: every cruising koi position, the default. 6: working koi smooth. 10: the rush to food smooth. 28: the dragonfly's dart, the functional max (nothing moves finer than a braille dot, and nothing moves faster). 60: for laughs; the same picture as 28, around a whole core.

workingFps.title: Rate while Claude works
workingFps.description: The most frames a second the pond runs at while a turn is running, since each model request keeps it awake and a long turn at a high rate would burn a core the whole way. The chosen frame rate comes back when the turn completes. same: no cap. The presets mean the same as under Frame rate; 28 is the functional max.
